name: AddressField
description:
AddressInput bound to an AddressValue form field. Each part is its own form field
(`<name>.line1`…), so `addressSchema()`'s messages land on the right row. Pair it with
`addressSchema()`.
signature: ({ label, hint, optional, required, className, ...options }: AddressFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: bias
props.description: Lean suggestions towards this point: the workspace's home region.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: countries
props.description: Only suggest addresses in these countries (ISO codes).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: geocoder
props.description: Where addresses come from. Default: Glass UX's server route (/api/geocode), Photon behind it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Supporting text in the field’s reserved message slot. Validation errors take precedence.

props.name: homeCountry
props.description: The country of a new address and the one not written on one-line addresses. Default "AU".

props.name: map
props.description: Show a map with the pin (MapLibre, lazy). Omit for no map.

props.name: optional
props.description: Shows the optional-field indication without changing validation.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.
